dataset.evaluation_protocol: Chronological online prediction: fixture i is scored from history = matches[0..i-1] (strictly earlier, no same-day, no future). Parameters re-estimated per fixture.

notes: Read-only evaluation: SELECT-only loaders; SHA-256 re-checked after load; any modification aborts.
No cross-competition leakage: load-time provider_competition_id filter isolates a single competition.
No same-day / future leakage: each fixture's history is the strict prefix of earlier-dated matches.
No model selection: hyperparameters are fixed; metrics are descriptive, not ranked as superiority claims.
Goal model is independent Poisson (no correlated-score correction).
Over/under and BTTS metrics use Brier score only.
